messages:
alex_support: Hey team — we have a P2 from Customer Success. Canary rollout health charts are stuck 'In progress' in the Console for multiple customers. Users see 0% healthy and the chart never updates even though traffic is routed. Ticket: #CS-1249 :grimacing:

maria_eng: Thanks. Any repro info? tenant id / canary id? Is this across regions or a single cluster?

alex_support: Repro on staging and prod. Example tenant: tenant-87, canary id: c-9f2a. Affected region: us-west-2. UI shows status: "In progress" since 09:42 UTC. API status endpoint returns "pending" as well.

kai_sre: Seeing related alerts — canary-controller reported repeated 409s to status-sync svc around 09:40. Deploy-bot, can you paste rollout events?

deploy-bot: rollout:c-9f2a started by emily_prodops at 2026-03-17T09:39:52Z
deployment-event:c-9f2a status-update POST -> status-sync svc returned 409 x 6 attempts

alex_support: Support captured this curl to reproduce status query:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/tenant-87/canaries/c-9f2a/status
# response:
# {"canary_id":"c-9f2a","state":"in_progress","healthy_percent":0,"last_sync":"2026-03-17T09:40:12Z"}
```

maria_eng: Can you include the controller logs and status-syncsvc logs from the same window? Suspect a race in status write + optimistic lock 409.

alex_support: Pasted a trimmed log snippet from canary-controller (09:39:58-09:41:00):
```
2026-03-17T09:40:00Z INFO reconciler: processing canary c-9f2a
2026-03-17T09:40:01Z ERROR status-sync: put /status/c-9f2a -> 409 conflict (version mismatch)
2026-03-17T09:40:02Z WARN reconciler: retrying status update (attempt 2)
2026-03-17T09:40:05Z INFO status-sync: put /status/c-9f2a -> 200
2026-03-17T09:40:06Z INFO metrics: emitted canary.health=75
```

emily_prodops: Interesting — controller emitted metrics showing health 75 but Console chart remained at 0. That suggests the metrics pipeline produced the value but the Console UI didn't pick up the updated snapshot.

kai_sre: I see two possible failure points: (1) status-sync service write conflict causing stale index state; (2) metrics ingestion delay for chart backend. Which path is used by Console for the rollout health view?

maria_eng: Console uses status-sync as the source of truth for the 'rollout health' panel (not raw metrics), and status-sync also has a separate indexing job that writes snapshot docs consumed by the frontend. If the indexing job fails or is delayed the UI stays stuck.

alex_support: Quick workaround requested by CS: any manual action to force index refresh so customer sees updated state?

maria_eng: We can force a reindex for the canary snapshot via an internal admin endpoint: POST /admin/index/refresh?canary_id=c-9f2a — requires admin token. Steps for SRE:
1) curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://internal.redwood.ai/admin/index/refresh?canary_id=c-9f2a
2) verify response 200 and then check console.

kai_sre: Doing that now on staging.

deploy-bot: admin-index-refresh initiated for c-9f2a by kai_sre at 2026-03-17T09:44:10Z

kai_sre: After refresh, Console shows healthy_percent 75 and chart updated. Workaround verified for staging.

alex_support: Great — can you run same on prod for the affected tenants? CS listed 3 affected: tenant-87, tenant-91, tenant-214.

kai_sre: Running queued refreshes now. Will post when complete.

maria_eng: Root cause hypothesis: status-sync's optimistic locking produced transient 409s. The code catches and retries but the indexing job gives up on certain sequences and leaves stale snapshot docs. Fix plan: patch status-sync to surface a guaranteed 'refresh' event when a put succeeds after retries so indexing job replays. I'll open a PR and schedule a canary deploy.

emily_prodops: Priority: hotfix patch to status-sync + indexer change. If not feasible in 1h, production manual refresh is acceptable but needs automation.

maria_eng: Filed ENG ticket: ENG-3301. PR to follow (will link). For now, adding a short-lived monitor to alert if canary.snapshot_age > 60s and ui_state != backend_state.

alex_support: CS notified customers and created work item with repro steps + temporary workaround. Thank you.

kai_sre: Prod refreshes complete for tenant-87/91/214 at 2026-03-17T09:51:20Z — customers reported UI update. Closing P2 after follow-up patch is deployed. :white_check_mark:

maria_eng: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/eng/status-sync/pulls/142 — patch includes emitting a "refresh_event" on retry-success and defensive requeue in indexer. Scheduling canary for 2pm UTC.

alex_support: Copy. I'll update the ticket and follow up with CS after the canary. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
